optimizedContext.value:
# Code Graph Composition

## Rules
- `CodeGraphProvider`: explicit `open()`/idempotent `close()`, `index`, `clear` logical reset, closed-only `recreate`; queries/traversal/search/impact delegate after one availability/staleness check. `force` reindexes logically, never physical recreation.
- Filtered impact accepts shared typed filter for all target families; push normalized predicates through traversal/store/worker; return deterministic filtered result including `affectedSpecs`. No post-projection filtering.
- `createCodeGraphProvider(config: SpecdConfig, options?)` derives storage from `config.configPath`; standalone overload requires `storagePath`. Select `graphStoreId ?? "sqlite"`; merge built-in sqlite and additive `graphStoreFactories`; reject sqlite collision/unknown id. Register TypeScript, Python, Go, PHP plus `adapters`; build `IndexCodeGraph`.
- `createSqliteGraphStoreFactory()` synchronous; runtime loading, worker start, schema prep, binding resolution at `open()`. Absolute `modulePath` converts to `file:` URL.
- Public provider type-only; construction only factory. `.` exposes curated composition, host use cases, graph config, index/traversal/impact/search/fingerprint/model/resolver/error vocabulary and `CODE_GRAPH_VERSION`; raw IPC, concrete stores, locks, launchers, worker/test helpers internal. `src/public.ts`=`.`; `src/index.ts`=`./internal`; publish non-exported isolated worker child.
- Already-open provider powers `GetGraphHealth`, `IndexProjectGraph`, `GetSpecCoverage`, `GetChangeSpecCoverage`; direct provider retains search/hotspots/impact/traversal.
- Symbol resolution: exact public-binding lookup; unqualified case-exact then case-insensitive exact only; no prefix/text widening; invalid selector typed `INVALID_GRAPH_SELECTOR`; candidate enrichment one batch lookup. Adapter normalization uses indexing registry; unanchored `Tipo.miembro`/`Tipo::miembro` matches `qualified_name`, other text needs explicit language/index anchor/surface metadata.
- Unified search owns query plan, semantic/content lanes, occurrence precision/suppression/grouping/ranking/limits. Exact file filters normalize canonical/config/absolute; wildcard stays pattern. Delivery adapters must not reimplement merge/dedup/limits.

## Constraints
- One active `GraphStore`; registry selection internal, not `specd.yaml`.
- `LanguageAdapter` public; stores/internals only `"./internal"`.
- Provider facade no domain logic; owns lifecycle, availability, locks, destructive recovery.
- `@specd/core` runtime dependency; config used only composition inputs; caller supplies targets/spec sources each `index()`.
